aur jab sitaray jharr parren gay ,
aur jab samandaron ko ubaal diya jaye ga ,
aur jab qabren ukhaar di jayen gi ,
uss waqt her shaks ko pata chal jaye ga kay uss ney kiya aagay bheja aur kiya peechay chorra .
aey insan ! tujhay kiss cheez ney apney uss perwerdigar kay moamlay mein dhoka laga diya hai jo bara karam wala hai ,
jiss ney tujhay peda kiya , phir tujhay theek theek banaya , phir teray andar aetidaal peda kiya-?
jiss soorat mein chaha , uss ney tujhay jorr ker tayyar kiya .
hergiz aisa nahi hona chahiye ,   lekin tum jaza o saza ko jhutlatay ho ,
halankay tum per kuch nigran ( farishtay ) muqarrar hain ,
jo tumharay saray kamon ko jantay hain .
yaqeen rakho kay naik log yaqeenan bari naimaton mein hon gay ,
aur bad-kaar log zaroor dozakh mein hon gay .
woh uss mein jaza o saza kay din dakhil hon gay ,
aur who uss say ghaeeb nahi hosaktay .
aur tumhen kiya pata kay jaza o saza ka din kiya cheez hai ?
haan tumhen kiya pata kay jaza o saza ka din kiya cheez hai ?
yeh woh din hoga jiss mein kissi doosray kay liye kuch kerna kissi kay bus mein nahi hoga , aur tamam tarr hukum uss din Allah hi ka chalay ga .
